_note: Post-match press questions. Context picks the pool: scored, missed (played, no goal, low rating), won, lost, benched, rumour, gaffer. Each answer has a tone (humble, cocky, funny, dig), effects on meters, and a quote for Monday's paper ({NAME}, {OPP}, {TEAM}).

scored.q: What a goal against {OPP}. Where does that rank in your career so far?

answers.text: "It's all about the team. The lads made it easy for me."
"Top of the list. Then again, I'm only 16, so it's a short list."
"I was aiming for the corner flag, to be honest."

scored.q: The fans were singing your name. How did that feel?

answers.text: "Unreal. I'll never take that for granted."
"They'd better get used to it."
"Louder than they sing for some of the others, that's for sure."

missed.q: You had chances today. What went wrong?

answers.text: "I should have done better. I'll be back on the training ground Monday."
"The service wasn't great, if I'm honest."
"The goal moved. I've got video evidence."

missed.q: Some fans are saying you're not ready. Are they right?

answers.text: "I've got a lot to learn. I'll prove them wrong."
"Some fans also think the Earth is flat."

won.q: Big win. How's the mood in the dressing room?

answers.text: "Buzzing. Credit to the gaffer, he had us ready."
"Gaz is doing his dance. It's horrific. Send help."
"We'll beat anyone playing like that. Anyone."

lost.q: Tough afternoon. Is the gaffer getting it wrong?

answers.text: "No chance. That's on us players."
"I'm not paid to pick the team. If I was, I'd be in it more."
"Honestly, I was just thinking about my tea."
"The gaffer picks the team. I'll keep working."
"Frustrated? I've been sat so long I've got splinters."

rumour.q: There's talk of bigger clubs watching you. Would you be tempted?

answers.text: "I'm happy here. I just want to play."
"Never say never. My agent's got a fax machine."
"The only club I'm joining is Gran's bingo club."

gaffer.q: What's the gaffer like to work for?

answers.text: "He's taught me loads. Mostly about fish, but loads."
"Bit old school. Thinks a tactics board is for drawing trout."
"Don't get him started on carp. Seriously. Don't."
